tools.name: search_sweepstakes
tools.description: Search free-to-enter US sweepstakes listed on UltimateSweepers.com, sorted by end date by default. Every result links to its UltimateSweepers listing with official rules, eligibility and the entry link.

tools.name: get_sweepstake
tools.description: Details for one sweepstake by its UltimateSweepers slug (the last part of an ultimatesweepers.com/s/<slug> link).

tools.name: list_sweepstakes_categories
tools.description: Prize categories, entry frequencies and the curated UltimateSweepers lists (ending today, daily entry, big prizes, …) with links.

tools.name: submit_sweepstake
tools.description: Know a free-to-enter sweepstake that isn't on UltimateSweepers yet? Send the link to the official entry or rules page. Our team checks the sponsor and official rules before anything is published. Free entry only: no paid raffles or purchase-required contests.
